title: Human Kinetics Methods
modules: Physical Education Concepts; The Analysis Of The Physical Education Teacher
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical component for the teacher."
Patience is a critical component for the teacher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for training athletes, scheduling practices and managing equipment."
Coaches are responsible for training athletes, scheduling practices and managing equipment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the common style in which the instructor stands in front of the class or group and lectures or advises, so as to teach a piece of information."
Direct teaching is the common style in which the instructor stands in front of the class or group and lectures or advises, so as to teach a piece of information.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a unit when viewed as a whole delineates a "decision map" (the objectives, teaching behavior, learning behavior, and outcomes that is O- T-L-O) that indicates a specific teaching style."

The three sets are a unit when viewed as a whole delineates a "decision map" (the objectives, teaching behavior, learning behavior, and outcomes that is O- T-L-O) that indicates a specific teaching style.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the local provision of an object or material to meet a particular need."
Improvisation is the local provision of an object or material to meet a particular need.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a legal term used in both common and civil law systems to describe various wrongs that may give rise to civil proceedings, mainly in the form of an action for damages."
Tort is a legal term used in both common and civil law systems to describe various wrongs that may give rise to civil proceedings, mainly in the form of an action for damages.
fib: ______ is a style in which the instructor assumes a more passive role and guides the student interactions.
Indirect teaching is a style in which the instructor assumes a more passive role and guides the student interactions.
______ is a form of occupation which demands constant and specialized training in an intellectual field of study.
Sport is a form of occupation which demands constant and specialized training in an intellectual field of study.
______ is a discipline which cuts across all other disciplines, especially the general education.
Physical education is a discipline which cuts across all other disciplines, especially the general education.
______ is a branch of private law, the law of contracts, in which the legal rules which regulate ''civil obligation'' are spelt out.
Torts is a branch of private law, the law of contracts, in which the legal rules which regulate ''civil obligation'' are spelt out.
______ is a tort that is often used to implicate teachers of physical education.
Negligence is a tort that is often used to implicate teachers of physical education.

______ refers to those objects that are commercially improvised or acquired by the teacher so that in the process of teaching, conceptual abstraction can be made to be concrete and more practical to the learner.

Instructional aids refers to those objects that are commercially improvised or acquired by the teacher so that in the process of teaching, conceptual abstraction can be made to be concrete and more practical to the learner.
